name: CAP Crest (embroidered eagle over shield with triangle and prop, scroll)
size_basis: Clean geometry (crest-art.js, LIVE11-ART) with every part measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A6-4 (the CAP Crest tile, base-art/board/crest-src/cap-crest-fig-a6-4.png; the figure is undimensioned) in crest units (705 units = 2.8 in, x from the axis, patch y 20..722): patch half-width 280 at the wing tips, 163 under the wings, 241 at the shield shoulder, 216 at the waist, 293 at the scroll ends; eagle wing tips +-248 at y 50, leading edge y 75 at x 120 and 50 at x 230, trailing edge y 119/137/151 at x 190/150/110, eye (-5, 81), lower body +-82 at y 220; bar +-149 x y 243..280 with three blue blocks; shield outer flat top y 287 (half 162, chamfer to 197 at y 317), half 197 at y 330, waist 177 at y 400, widest 200 at y 518, point y 650, gold ring 13 (field point 637); triangle outer apex y 304, base y 567, half-base 168, gold edge 7; prop hub (0, 478), blade 134 (blade profile from the command-patch prop); scroll bottom = arc R 392 about (0, 310), top flat at y 512 to x 228 falling to 528 at the shield, ends at +-262, fold at +-238, lettering cap 32 on the R 365 arc. Base-art/crest/compare-crest.js reads the same landmarks off the figure and the render: all within 1.3% of the patch height. Height 2.8 in = the crest measured in CAPR 39-1 Figs 4.14/4.15 against the 3 3/8 in nametag plate (about 2.6 in in Fig 4.14, 3.0 in in Fig 4.15).
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: CAP Crest attached or sewn to the centre of the left breast pocket (CAPR 39-1 4.2.3.1.1.1)
assumed: patch bottom below the figure crop (the tile is cut at y 705): scroll bottom arc + 20-unit border
bar blocks drawn centred (the figure embroidery has them 25 units right of centre)
eagle feather lines, talons and head outline drawn to the measured outline, not measured individually
triangle as drawn in the figure (apex angle 64 deg, not equilateral)
